dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Highly falcate trailing edge characterized by a deep, smooth concave spline from the dorsal insertion to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Narrowly rounded morphology with a small pixel radius at the terminal dorsal point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex anterior margin with a steepening incline relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum visible base width to vertical height ratio of approximately 1.2:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small singular notch visible on the posterior margin immediately below the apex; minor white punctate markings on the anterior-ventral surface of the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct tonal contrast between the dark pigmentation of the dorsal fin and the lighter gray pigmentation of the dorsal ridge.
